spreadsheet-clip.name: pass-topic
spreadsheet-clip.evidence:
**`--topic="Kestrel offline rollout"` is the load-bearing flag.** Topic is recorded
     going forward only and no tool can retro-fit it

spreadsheet-clip.name: verify-extraction
spreadsheet-clip.evidence:
**Verify the capture rather than trusting the exit code.** Read the returned
   `raw/clippings/<slug>.md` and confirm each sheet came through as a real table with its
   labels still attached to its values.

spreadsheet-clip.name: request-ingest-decision
spreadsheet-clip.evidence:
I stopped before ingest. You authorized capturing this file, not adding it to wiki pages —
say the word and I'll run `/wiki-ingest` on it to produce a `wiki/sources/` summary.

purge-orphan-lineage.name: reconcile-first
purge-orphan-lineage.evidence:
`node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/purge.mjs" --reconcile` — sweeps anything an
   earlier purge lost on this machine; cheap and silent on a clean vault; owns its commit.

purge-orphan-lineage.name: review-seeds
purge-orphan-lineage.evidence:
**Read the seed list first, before reading the plan.** Ranking has no notion of "relevant
   enough"

purge-orphan-lineage.name: request-explicit-approval
purge-orphan-lineage.evidence:
Then read the plan back grouped by layer with counts, naming the blocking and collateral
   pages specifically, and get an explicit yes.

purge-orphan-lineage.name: resolve-blocking
purge-orphan-lineage.evidence:
I put that
     choice to the user as a choice, named page by page; purge will not decide it silently
     in either direction and neither will I.

triage-queue.name: hand-over-tokened-link
triage-queue.evidence:
hand the user **`link`**, never `url`. Every route sits behind a session
   token and only `link` carries it

triage-queue.name: summarize-what-waits
triage-queue.evidence:
What's waiting, by research topic first, since that's usually how you want to work through it:

- **Kestrel offline rollout** — N failed clips (the 403s), 1 fidelity flag

triage-queue.name: end-turn-for-user-decision
triage-queue.evidence:
Disposition what you want in the browser and
tell me when you're done; I'll read your choices back and act on them then.

unsupported-claim-query.name: cite-paths
unsupported-claim-query.evidence:
- `wiki/concepts/<Kestrel Offline Sync>.md:NN` — states the guarantee as <…>.
- `wiki/syntheses/<…>.md:NN` — states it as <…>.

unsupported-claim-query.name: inspect-evidence
unsupported-claim-query.evidence:
**Verify the citation trail rather than assuming it.** Pipe the hits through
   `node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/resolve-evidence.mjs"`.

unsupported-claim-query.name: disclose-degraded-capture
unsupported-claim-query.evidence:
The first page's only evidence is `raw/clippings/<…>.md`, which was recorded as a
  **degraded capture**. That clipping is genuine evidence the vault holds this source, but a
  degraded capture can't be trusted at character level

relink-scope.name: run-health-first
relink-scope.evidence:
**Report the defects.** `node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/health.mjs"` for unresolved
   links and orphans

relink-scope.name: open-operation
relink-scope.evidence:
**Open the operation before the first write**, saving the token:
   `node "C:/plugins/wiki-master/scripts/op-begin.mjs" --op relink`

relink-scope.name: preserve-user-work
relink-scope.evidence:
so if a broken link turns out to live *inside* one of
   those two dirty pages, I leave that one alone and report it rather than editing underneath
   the user. Never `git add -A` in a vault.

relink-scope.name: scoped-commit
relink-scope.evidence:
Then **inspect what it actually committed** — specifically that the user's two files are not
   in it
